newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED IN THIN TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED IN THIN TRADE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed against major currencies in thin trade at the end of Tuesday's interbank session.
"It was generally quiet with very thin trading. Not much happened on the interbank market and the dollar didn't move much from earlier levels," one foreign exchange dealer said.
At the day's close, the local unit was quoted at 10.5250/5450 against the U.S. dollar compared to its 10.5200/5400 position at the end of business on Monday.

On the crosses, it weakened to 16.6510/6920 against sterling from 16.6060/6470, reflecting the British currency's gains on the U.S. dollar on overseas markets but it firmed to 6.8390/8530 against the mark from 6.8780/8920 also in reflection of the German unit's losses on international markets.
The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted marginally easier on the rand at 2.3170/3230 compared to 2.3160/3220.
